rag.name: nsfw_image_detection
rag.summary: NSFW图像检测模型基于Vision Transformer架构，能够自动识别图像中的不适宜内容，解决用户生成内容的审核难题。该模型通过自注意力机制分析图像不同区域的关联特征，有效捕捉复杂视觉模式，实现对多种敏感内容的准确分类。开发者可直接调用Hugging Face接口集成到内容审核系统，或针对特定场景需求微调模型参数，构建符合自身业务规范的内容过滤解决方案。

rag.name: chronos-bolt-tiny
rag.summary: Chronos-Bolt-Tiny 是一个轻量级时间序列预测模型，专为资源受限的边缘计算环境设计，解决了在设备端部署AI预测的难题。它采用T5架构，通过独特的标记化技术将连续时间序列数据转换为离散标记，从而能够利用预训练语言模型的能力来捕捉复杂的时间模式。该模型可通过Hugging Face管道进行微调，适用于物联网传感器监测、能源消耗预测或零售需求分析等场景，开发者只需少量数据即可快速适配特定领域，实现高效的时间序列推理。
rag.summary_en: Chronos-Bolt-Tiny is a lightweight time series forecasting model that enables accurate predictions on resource-constrained devices, addressing the challenge of deploying AI forecasting in edge computing environments. It employs a T5-based architecture with tokenization techniques that convert continuous time series data into discrete tokens, allowing it to leverage pre-trained language model capabilities for temporal patterns. Developers can fine-tune it on custom datasets using Hugging Face pipelines, making it suitable for IoT sensor monitoring, energy consumption forecasting, or retail demand prediction applications where computational efficiency is critical.

text_to_image.name: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B
text_to_image.summary: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B 是一个大型多模态语言模型，能够同时处理图像和文本输入以生成对话式回复，解决了AI在对话中理解视觉上下文的需求。其技术核心采用混合专家架构，通过根据输入动态激活不同的专家子网络，实现了350亿参数的高效扩展，在保持强大能力的同时优化了计算资源。开发者可利用Hugging Face平台进行微调，应用于视觉问答、结合图像的智能客服等场景，或通过API集成到需要多模态交互的应用中，探索视觉与语言融合的实践。
text_to_image.summary_en: Qwen3.5-35B-A3B is a large multimodal language model that processes both images and text to generate conversational responses, addressing the need for AI that can understand visual context in dialogue. It employs a Mixture of Experts (MoE) architecture, where specialized sub-networks activate selectively based on input, enabling efficient scaling to 35 billion parameters while maintaining computational feasibility. Developers can fine-tune it for applications like visual question answering or integrate it into chatbots that interpret uploaded images, using the Hugging Face transformers library for deployment.

model_compression.name: all-mpnet-base-v2
